summary: A1 triage of ep 79 (filler, afg ch-219). The body is wholly anime-original Jaken comedy (No-man demon, fake-sharpener ruse, hot-spring Tessaiga theft), the tail of AFL's contiguous 75-79 filler run - the type is right. But the afg 219 is not pure position either: the fandom episode infobox lists Chapter 219 qualified 'end of the episode', and ch 219 'Kidnapped' maps back to eps 79 AND 80 - the closing tag adapts ch 219's opening beat (Kagura kidnaps Rin in front of Jaken, re-staged in a melon field), and ep 80 does NOT re-show it (it resumes at Jaken's report and covers 219-221). A tag-sized partial on a filler row is exactly the shape Sean ruled on with the CCS ep-7 override: type stays filler, fact goes to an annotation, anchor goes. Position is fully carried by ep 80 (219-221). AFG-tier row: per the 2026-08-24 apply contract the applied repair must flip the anchor source to manual, or the next AFG re-derive restores the deleted value (the class D4's writer-side gate would close for good).
